data
  repository            object
    projectKey          string                          Project key the repository belongs to.
    slug                string                          Repository slug.
  pullRequest           object                          The pull request as it stands after the
                                                        change.
    id                  integer                         Pull request number, unique within the
                                                        repository.
    title               string                          Pull request title.
    description?        string                          Body text, when one was written.
    state               OPEN|MERGED|DECLINED
    open                boolean                         Whether the pull request is still open.
    closed              boolean                         Whether the pull request is merged or
                                                        declined.
    draft?              boolean                         Whether it is marked as a draft. Bitbucket
                                                        8.0 and later.
    repository?         object                          Repository the pull request merges into.
      projectKey        string                          Project key the repository belongs to.
      slug              string                          Repository slug.
    sourceRepository?   object                          Repository the source branch lives in.
                                                        Differs from repository exactly when the
                                                        pull request comes from a fork, which is the
                                                        only way to tell a fork pull request from a
                                                        same-repository one.
      projectKey        string                          Project key the repository belongs to.
      slug              string                          Repository slug.
    version             integer                         Optimistic-locking version. Pass it back
                                                        when updating, or the update is refused.
                                                        Always present: a never-updated pull request
                                                        is at version 0, and omitting it there would
                                                        drop the value at exactly the moment a
                                                        caller needs it.
    author?             string                          Display name of whoever opened it.
    authorUsername?     string                          Username of whoever opened it.
    sourceBranch?       string                          Branch being merged from.
    targetBranch?       string                          Branch being merged into.
    sourceCommit?       string                          Head commit of the source branch when this
                                                        was read.
    createdDate?        integer                         When it was opened, in milliseconds since
                                                        the epoch.
    updatedDate?        integer                         When it last changed, in milliseconds since
                                                        the epoch.
    reviewers?          list of object                  Everyone asked to review, with where they
                                                        got to.
      name?             string                          Username.
      displayName?      string                          Human-readable name.
      email?            string                          Email address, when the instance exposes it.
      role?             AUTHOR|REVIEWER|PARTICIPANT     REVIEWER or PARTICIPANT.
      status?           UNAPPROVED|NEEDS_WORK|APPROVED
      approved          boolean                         Whether this reviewer has approved. A
                                                        convenience for status == APPROVED.
    mergeability?       object                          Whether it can merge. Absent when not
                                                        requested or not computed.
      mergeable         boolean                         Whether Bitbucket would accept a merge right
                                                        now.
      outcome?          CLEAN|CONFLICTED|UNKNOWN
      conflicted        boolean                         Whether the merge would conflict. Distinct
                                                        from mergeable, which is also false when a
                                                        merge check fails without any conflict.
      blockers?         list of object                  Merge checks currently refusing. Absent when
                                                        nothing is blocking.
        summary?        string                          Short reason, as Bitbucket phrases it.
        detail?         string                          Longer explanation, when the instance gives
                                                        one.
    commentCount?       integer                         Comments on the pull request. Absent when
                                                        the instance did not report it, which is not
                                                        the same as none.
    openTaskCount?      integer                         Unresolved tasks. Absent when the instance
                                                        did not report it.
    resolvedTaskCount?  integer                         Resolved tasks. Absent when the instance did
                                                        not report it.
